prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Predictions were mostly too high compared to actual noise-corrected results, except for sign_in notification where the prediction was too low.
No effect was seen for adoption redesign changes across 2 tests.
Evidence is still thin for adoption new_flow, finish new_screen, sign_in notification, and sign_in reorder, as each has only 1 test.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, new_flow: -5.3% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- adoption, redesign: -1.3% after noise correction, 2 test(s)
- finish, new_screen: -6.1% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- sign_in, notification: +7.6% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- sign_in, reorder: -0.1% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 79.3%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 60.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 19.4%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [adoption, hint] Photo Upload Troubleshooting Tooltips: Add clear image formatting hints and helper callouts directly on the photo upload screen. (why: Support logs contain 3 emails about custom pet generation failing or looking wrong, and adoption step drop-off is high at 39.1%.)
1: [home, new_flow] Pet Generation Activity Waiting Flow: Transform the waiting screen into an interactive splash screen with animated updates and pet care trivia while generation finishes. (why: The waiting home step has an extremely long mean duration (2336s) and drop-off rate of 18.7%, showing users get impatient during generation.)
2: [finish, hint] Pet Desktop Hotkey Callout: Add an explicit quick-reference component on home_intro explaining shortcut keys to hide, move, or interact with the pet. (why: 3 support tickets logged post-onboarding confusion regarding how to control, hide, or talk to their new desktop pet.)
3: [sign_in, reorder] Sign In Step Relocation After Companion Choice: Move the sign_in step to occur after selecting a friend in the adoption flow rather than beforehand. (why: Requiring sign-in before picking a companion causes early drop-off (20.7% lose rate at sign_in) before emotional attachment is established.)
4: [adoption, notification] Upload Photo Timeout Alert: Add a tip notification after 30 seconds on the photo upload screen offering sample pet templates if photo uploading takes too long. (why: Adoption mean time is 1017s, indicating users frequently get stuck trying to find or format suitable photos.)
5: [choose_path, copy] Story Screen Express Onboarding Copy: Revise story screen text to emphasize that setup takes under 60 seconds to get your pet running on your desktop. (why: The choose_path stage has a high mean time of 514s, showing early friction before users begin customizing.)
